title: 221S-1a inhibits endothelial proliferation in pathological angiogenesis through ERK/c-Myc signaling.
authors: Yao, Xinye; Xue, Yanbo; Ma, Qiang; Bai, Yajun; Jia, Pu; Zhang, Yiman; Lai, Baochang; He, Shuting; Ma, Qiong; Zhang, Junbo; Tian, Hongyan; Yin, Qian; Zheng, Xiaohui; Zheng, Xiaopu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究化合物221S-1a通过ERK/c-Myc通路抑制病理性血管生成，仅涉及c-Myc转录因子表达变化，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Pathological angiogenesis plays a major role in many disease processes, including cancer and diabetic retinopathy. Antiangiogenic therapy is a potential management for pathologic angiogenesis. The novel synthetic compound 221S-1a, derived from captopril, tanshinol and borneol, may have antiangiogenic properties. On the basis of MS, NMR and HPLC analysis, the structure of 221S-1a was identified. The cellular uptake and metabolism of this compound was also observed. Next, the antiangiogenic properties of 221S-1a were evaluated in tumor-xenograft and OIR models in vivo. The inhibitory properties of 221S-1a on endothelial cell proliferation, migration, tube formation and sprouting were detected in vitro. Furthermore, 221S-1a induced G1/S phase arrest was detected by PI staining flow cytometry analysis and Cyclin D, Cyclin E expression. 221S-1a inhibited ERK1/2 activation and nuclear translocation, in addition to downregulation of c-Myc, a transcription factor that regulates cell cycle progression. Molecular docking indicated the interaction of 221S-1a with the ATP-binding site of ERK2, leading to the inhibition of ERK2 phosphorylation and a concomitant inhibition of ERK1 phosphorylation. In conclusion, 221S-1a inhibited the G1/S phase transition by blocking the ERK1/2/c-Myc pathway to reduce tumor and OIR retinal angiogenesis. These novel findings suggest that 221S-1a is a potential pharmacologic candidate for treating pathological angiogenesis.
abstract_zh: 病理性血管生成在包括癌症和糖尿病视网膜病变在内的许多疾病过程中发挥重要作用。抗血管生成治疗是病理性血管生成的潜在管理方法。新型合成化合物221S-1a，源自卡托普利、丹参素和冰片，可能具有抗血管生成特性。基于MS、NMR和HPLC分析，鉴定了221S-1a的结构。同时观察了该化合物的细胞摄取和代谢。接下来，在体内肿瘤异种移植和OIR模型中评估了221S-1a的抗血管生成特性。在体外检测了221S-1a对内皮细胞增殖、迁移、管形成和出芽的抑制特性。此外，通过PI染色流式细胞术分析和Cyclin D、Cyclin E表达检测了221S-1a诱导的G1/S期阻滞。221S-1a抑制了ERK1/2的激活和核转位，并下调了调节细胞周期进程的转录因子c-Myc。分子对接表明221S-1a与ERK2的ATP结合位点相互作用，导致ERK2磷酸化抑制，并伴随ERK1磷酸化的抑制。总之，221S-1a通过阻断ERK1/2/c-Myc通路抑制G1/S期转变，以减少肿瘤和OIR视网膜血管生成。这些新发现表明221S-1a是治疗病理性血管生成的潜在药物候选物。
